recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochrome composite featuring a 5x4 grid of figures positioned on white spiral staircases against a solid black void, topped with a horizontal line of dot-matrix display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-key white subjects against a low-key black background
Rhythmic verticality created by stacked staircase modules
Typographic texture echoing the digital/mechanical structure of the grid
coreInvariants: Modular repetition of the staircase asset

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple small-scale figures distributed evenly across a 5-column grid, occupying the central and lower 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal typographic header at the top edge provides a structural cap to the vertical columns.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves vertically down each column, following the curves of the spiral stairs, then jumps horizontally across the grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the grid and separates the individual staircase modules, emphasizing isolation.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone greys (clothing textures and typographic gradients)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Characters built from horizontal pill-shaped segments
Uniform stroke width based on segment size
characterSpecificRedesigns: Curved letters like 'C', 'S', and 'O' are rendered with stepped horizontal bars
The letter 'A' features a flat top
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all text to maintain mechanical consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the segmented, digital display aesthetic.
Captures the structural grid-like nature of the glyphs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 5x4 grid of identical white spiral staircases on a solid black background. Place a different male figure in various poses on each staircase, all wearing monochrome clothing (white, grey, black). Use high-contrast studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase text at the top. Use a custom font constructed from horizontal pill-shaped segments to create a digital scoreboard effect. Apply a subtle white-to-grey gradient across the text.

verificationChecks: Check that the grid alignment is perfectly symmetrical.
Verify the text is composed of distinct horizontal segments.
Confirm no colors other than black, white, and grey are present.

adjustableVariables: Number of grid columns and rows
Density of the dot-matrix segments in the text
Tightness of the spiral on the staircases
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
Specific clothing patterns that are brand-identifiable

mustAchieve: Perfect vertical and horizontal grid alignment
Consistent lighting direction across all 20 modules
Clean, sharp edges on the staircase geometry

postGenerationChecks: Is the text at the top segmented?
Are the staircases white against a black void?
Is the lighting consistent across all subjects?
recipe.reuseFormula: Grid of [Subject] on [Architectural Element] + [Solid Background] + [Segmented Display Typography]
